episodes.title: The Last One
episodes.summary: An orb is tossed upon the earth. It transforms to match its surrounding environment: first a rock, then moss, then a dying wolf. The wolf returns to its last remaining family, a boy living alone in a small home in the snow.

episodes.title: A Rambunctious Girl
episodes.summary: The orb, having morphed into a boy, finds its way to Ninanna, where he is attacked. He is discovered by a girl, March, who may not achieve her goal of becoming a grown-up.

episodes.title: A Minor Evolution
episodes.summary: March is escorted to the altar to be sacrificed to Oniguma. Along the way, she tends to Fushi, who, despite having the body of a young man, doesn't seem to have the mind of one.

episodes.title: A Large Vessel
episodes.summary: Hayase, interested in Fushi's inability to die, brings him along with March, Parona and Pioran to the nation of Yanome. They are shown around town and treated well, but things are not as they seem.

episodes.title: Those Who Follow
episodes.summary: Fushi, March and Parona continue their escape from Yanome and back to Ninanna. Hayase chases after them, especially in order to capture Fushi.

episodes.title: Our Goals
episodes.summary: Having gained a semblance of humanity, Fushi sets off on his own. He encounters Pioran again, who teachers him words and writing, helping him live as a human being.

episodes.title: The Boy Who Wants To Change
episodes.summary: Fushi and Pioran arrive at Takunaha, where they meet Booze Man and a boy named Gugu. Gugu, who had been living with Booze Man for several months following an accident, warms up to Fushi.

episodes.title: The Two Monsters
episodes.summary: Fushi explains to Gugu how his form as the wolf, Joaan, and March, came to be. Gugu explains death to Fushi. Together, they come to understand the meaning of family.

episodes.title: Deep Memories
episodes.summary: Fushi tells Gugu about the wolf, Joaan, and the boy he took on the form of. Gugu explains death to Fushi, recalling his own past, working for a wealthy family with his brother.

episodes.title: New Family
episodes.summary: Fushi and Gugu fight against the Nokkers that they encountered in the forest. Though the situation is grim, Gugu has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes.title: Gift From the Past
episodes.summary: Four years after their encounter with the Nokkers, Fushi and Gugu have grown into fine young men. They're invited to Rean's birthday party after a brief reunion with Gugu's brother.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: Just as Gugu and Rean come to understand each other, the Nokkers emerge, causing panic in the party hall. Fushi and Gugu are forced to fight.

episodes.title: Aspiring to Go Higher
episodes.summary: Fushi leaves Booze Man's home and sets out to wander aimlessly around Takunaha. He has many questions for the Observer, but can't seem to get any straight answers.

episodes.title: Jananda, Island of Freedom
episodes.summary: Fushi and Pioran are separated on the prison island of Jananda. He enters a tournament where, if he survives until the end, he will be granted the right to do anything he wants – including leaving the island with Pioran.

episodes.title: A Girl Named Tonari
episodes.summary: Fushi transforms into Parona of Ninannah in the middle of the tournament. He is shocked when he realizes what this implies. Meanwhile, Tonari, desperate to have Fushi join her and her friends, offers to help rescue Pioran.

episodes.title: The Children's Dreams
episodes.summary: Fushi just barely manages to take down the Nokkers. He opens up to the others, and they discuss their dreams and pasts.

episodes.title: The Defeated
episodes.summary: Having defeated Fushi, Hayase makes a surprising proposal to the people of the island of Jananda.

episodes.title: To Continue On
episodes.summary: Tonari returns to Jananda to rescue Fushi. Before setting out again, they stay the night in a cave, and Tonari shares her past.

episodes.title: Wandering Rage
episodes.summary: Fushi, Tonari and their friends fight the Nokkers, who have taken over corpses.

episodes.title: Echoes
episodes.summary: Fushi parts ways with Tonari and heads to the port where Pioran is waiting for him. He worries that he may attract the Nokkers again and endanger her.

episodes.title: Infatuation Reborn
episodes.summary: Fushi, having spent several decades alone on an island, learns that a village was attacked by the Nokkers.

episodes.title: The Young Man Who Can See
What You Want to Protect
episodes.summary: Amidst the brutal battle against the Nokkers, Bon and Kahaku both share a desire to protect Fushi's humanity. How they go about it, however, puts them at odds.

episodes.title: Peaceful World
episodes.summary: Fushi awakens in a world where peace reigns. What new and old encounters await him?

episodes.title: A Knot in the Soul
episodes.summary: Fushi begins his new life in the present day and begins to gather his former classmates at Yuki's house.

episodes.title: Mizuha
episodes.summary: Mizuha is fed up with her everyday life and decides to run away.

episodes.title: The One Who Vanished
episodes.summary: Fushi takes care of a troubled Mizuha.

episodes.title: Unheard Words
episodes.summary: Fushi and his revived friends joins Yuki and Mizuha at school.

episodes.title: Proof of Peace
episodes.summary: Fushi struggles to maintain the peace between Tonari and Mizuha.

episodes.title: The Attack
episodes.summary: The mystery of the Nokker inside Mimori is clarified a little, as it seeks Fushi at the school to attack him.

episodes.title: Trouble
episodes.summary: Hirotoshi reveals Mimori's deeply troubled past.

episodes.title: Rejected Life
episodes.summary: Fushi and Bon try to save Mimori at Hirotoshi's request, but a new Nokker appears.

episodes.title: Become as People
episodes.summary: Rikuya is found destroyed. The Nokkers confront Fushi.

episodes.title: Their Home
episodes.summary: Fushi has an opportunity to deal with the Nokker in Izumi's body.

episodes.title: Flying Bug
episodes.summary: Fushi transforms into small creatures to keep an eye on Mizuha and Funa. Meanwhile, Eko gives Yuki an idea.

episodes.title: Number One
episodes.summary: Fushi goes back to school, but as Fuuna. He learns about what people really think.

episodes.title: Where One Belongs
episodes.summary: Gugu confesses to being homesick. Fushi struggles to come to terms with his friends growing distant.

episodes.title: Leaving Alone
episodes.summary: Bon describes how Fushi's friends spent their time after he went to sleep centuries prior.

episodes.title: Connective
episodes.summary: Fushi and his friends look for ways to get back in touch with Mizuha.

episodes.title: Invisible Battle
episodes.summary: Fushi tries desperately to negotiate with Mizuha. Meanwhile, an impostor attacks the school.

episodes.title: A Willingness to Believe
episodes.summary: Tonari, Aiko and their schoolmates fight the Fushi impostor.

episodes.title: Clean Water
episodes.summary: Yuki and the crew negotiate a peace with the Guardians.

episodes.title: Coexist
episodes.summary: Fushi and his friends return to Yuki's place to discuss how they should avoid being arrested.

episodes.title: Stay Here
episodes.summary: The class needs to decide what they're doing after middle school. Fushi's decision is much weightier.

episodes.title: To Fushi
episodes.summary: The Beholder leaves Fushi with a memo.
